entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As per the case of prosecution, the petitioner/accused committed rape with the minor daughter of the informant by entering into her house at 9 O'clock at night.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner has been implicated in the case due to some past enmity and there was also delay of four days in lodging the FIR.
Learned APP for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer.

It is submitted that the delay occurred in lodging the FIR cannot be said to be inordinate delay considering the nature of offence which was committed by the petitioner who happened to be uncle of the victim minor girl.
The statement of the girl was recorded under Section 164 Cr. P.C. in which she has fully supported the case of prosecution.
Considering gravity of offence and materials on record, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on regular bail and accordingly, prayer for the same is rejected.
